value.rationale: The claim completely resolves the smallest nontrivial RSD ordinal-efficiency case, giving a natural exact frequency, a symmetry quotient, a structural collapse from arbitrary cycles to reciprocal pairs, and a minimum-complexity classification. These data refine the canonical four-agent counterexample and directly complement the asymptotic theory.
